host.note: The OS is the host PC platform; SteamVR sees a separate HMD device registered by the OpenVR driver.

steamvr.pose_packet: 7 little-endian IEEE-754 float32 values: x,y,z metres then quaternion w,x,y,z
steamvr.render_transport: prototype-only; a complete compositor/display transport is still required

openxr.initial_route: SteamVR OpenXR runtime through the registered OpenVR driver
openxr.ar_advertisement_policy: Only advertise an AR blend mode if the selected runtime and the actual optical/display or passthrough camera pipeline support it.

enabled_when: a live pose source is connected
an XR compositor and display/streaming output path are implemented
the GPU and runtime support the target application
real optical see-through or camera passthrough is available
the OpenXR runtime can compose with the real-world underlay
the camera/display permissions and calibration are valid
